thread:
alex.kim: Morning all — quick async standup. TL;DR: small SLO blip last night, follow-ups below. What I did: checked error rates, validated fallback routing. Blockers: waiting on canary logs from infra. Today: finalize alert tuning + ping CR reviewers.

maria.nguyen: Saw the blip around 02:13 UTC — ~30s spike in 5xxs from router-2. I ran the quick aggregation, looks like queue buildup during a kernel GC on that host. Error budget impact ~2.1%. Not critical but worth tuning the alert threshold.

oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Alert auto-ack at 2026-03-17T02:14:05Z for SLO:inference_latency_p95 > 800ms. Incident ID: INC-2026-281. Escalation paused due to automatic throttling.

sam.patel: Thanks Maria. Can you drop the host logs link? I looked at the router trace and saw a retry storm from a single client id. We might add a short circuit for noisy clients.

maria.nguyen: link: https://redwood.internal/logs/hosts/router-2/2026-03-17/02:12-02:20 — filtered for 5xx and retry headers. Also opened PR with a safeguard: PR #2543. Needs one more review.

jen.lopez: Quick note on rolling canary: deploy-bot showed a 0.8% increase in tail latency during canary step 3. It's within expected variance but flagged the alert. I'm going to relax the canary threshold by 10ms for the next rollout while we root cause.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout 2026-03-17T03:10: initiated -> step 1/4 succeeded. Observed metrics: p50: 42ms, p95: 370ms.

sam.patel: For reviewers: PR #2543 touches routing logic. Minimal change. cc @alex.kim @jen.lopez — can someone take a quick pass? Small unit tests added.

alex.kim: I'll review in ~30m. Also, Maria, can you add a note in the SLO postmortem doc about single-client noise? Link: https://redwood.internal/docs/slo/postmortems/INC-2026-281-draft.

maria.nguyen: Will do. Also toggled ephemeral caching on router-2 to test reduction in backend calls. Monitoring it now.

oncall-bot: Reminder: oncall rotation tomorrow at 08:00 PT -> sam.patel takes primary, jen.lopez secondary.

sam.patel: Got it. I'll pick up the handoff checklist tonight.

alex.kim: Blockers for me: want the canary logs (step 3) aggregated; if deploy-bot can post the aggregated diff that'd be helpful. Otherwise no blockers.

deploy-bot: Cached canary metrics diff uploaded: https://redwood.internal/metrics/canary/2026-03-17/step3-diff.json

jen.lopez: Quick check: should we bump the alert window from 5m to 10m for p95 alerts to reduce noise from short-lived spikes? My vote = yes for router-level alerts, keep 5m for cluster-level.

sam.patel: +1 for router-level 10m. Reduces churn. Create a quick PR to change the alert rule?

alex.kim: I'll create the alert PR after I review #2543. If anyone wants to take it, go ahead.

maria.nguyen: Done with the postmortem note and added a short mitigation (client-side throttling suggestion). No further action from me.

alex.kim: Thanks team. Final actions: alex -> review PR #2543 and alert PR, jen -> watch canary today, sam -> oncall tomorrow + merge PR after green CI. If anything urgent, ping here or call. :thumbsup:
